5078-5741-7297-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4549-6244--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding an additional mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Saradoc triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

339-677-728-6633.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1170-5131-6289-6797--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6289-6797--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Voyager Quickwelder.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

1170-3375-5131-5315--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3375-5131-5315--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to The Immortal Sun.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

443-2738-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Magus of the Bridge, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

301-1768-7859.description:
Activate Goblin Chirurgeon by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin and Juniper Order Ranger
Resolve the Goblin Chirurgeon ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1358-3899-4552-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
539-1358-3899-4552-7803.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Sydri
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

4399-4518-5998-6823.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Aunt May trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Aunt May trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-5998-6823.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1409-3099-4742-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1368-3480-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3480-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

240-803-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Arcane Adaptation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-803-3967.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

4050-5058-7422.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4321-4478.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2149-2440-7375.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Zaffai
1618-2149-2440-7375.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Arc Blade.
Arc Blade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Zaffai triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Arc Blade.
Repeat.
1618-2149-2440-7375.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Zaffai. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

3129-5742-5743-7178.description:
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Iron-Shield Elf ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1414-5295.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1849-3518.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2173-4446-4905-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
2173-4446-4905-5220.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

198-826-3767-3918.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on Trazyn.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
198-826-3767-3918.notes: The mana cost is {0} if Trazyn has a charge counter on it.

1636-3859-6406.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures such that you can cast Cavern Harpy between mana produced by those creatures and its convoke ability.
1636-3859-6406.description:
Cast Cavern Harpy by tapping a number of creatures and paying {0}.
When Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Cavern Harpy trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-3859-6406.notes: You can tap creatures for mana instead if that's more advantageous, and use that mana when casting the creature.

813-1922-2103.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Blur.
813-1922-2103.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2267-3240-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {B}.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3204-4251-4359-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
3204-4251-4359-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2438-2523-5562.notablePrerequisites: Stalwarts of Osgiliath is your Ring-bearer.
2438-2523-5562.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Stalwarts of Osgiliath.
When Stalwarts of Osgiliath dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Stalwarts of Osgiliath that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Stalwarts of Osgiliath token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Stalwarts of Osgiliath token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2855-5982.notablePrerequisites: Ancient Gold Dragon does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2855-5982.description:
Deal combat damage using Ancient Gold Dragon.
Ancient Gold Dragon triggers, causing you to roll a d20 and create that many 1/1 Faerie Dragon creature tokens.
When the Faerie Dragons enter the battlefield, Dragon Tempest's second ability triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing damage to any target equal to the number of Dragons you control.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
2855-5982.notes: The amount of damage this combo deals is highly variable by how many Dragons you control and the result of the d20 roll. The more Dragons you control, the more damage will be dealt. It can also be repeated, if needed.

2034-2284-4343.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional untapped creature.
2034-2284-4343.description:
Activate Glare of Subdual by tapping an untapped creature you control, tapping a creature an opponent controls.
Hylda of the Icy Crown triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature tapped in step 1, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Hylda of the Icy Crown trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 4/4 Elemental creature token.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each turn.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

3169-4013-4659-5263.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero, adding {C}{C}.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader enters the battlefield, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader, causing it to return to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero enters the battlefield, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Repeat.

914-1770-4770.notablePrerequisites: Panharmonicon on the battlefield.Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1770-4770.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{W}.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, returning itself and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1849-2703-3518-5112.description:
Activate Mairsil using Myr Propagator's ability by paying {3} and tapping it.
Holding priority, activate Mairsil using Lion's Eye Diamond's ability by sacrificing Mairsil and discarding your hand, adding {3}.
Resolve the Mairsil ability from step 1, creating a token copy of it.
Repeat.

1558-1635-4840.notablePrerequisites: Terror of Towashi does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1558-1635-4840.description:
Declare Terror of Towashi as an attacker.
Terror of Towashi triggers, causing you to pay {3}{B} to return Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and sacrificing the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2034-2233-5046.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Grim Betrayal has at least one indestructible counter on it.
2034-2233-5046.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Martyr for the Cause, adding {C}{C}.
When Martyr for the Cause dies, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, returning Martyr for the Cause from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1972-3765.manaNeeded: {8}{U}{B}{R}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1972-3765.description:
Cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Cast Nekusar from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{B}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
Whenever your opponent draw a card during their draw step, Nekusar causes them to draw an additional card and triggers twice.
Resolve the first Nekusar trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining opponent.

877-1265-2549.description:
Cast Niambi by paying {0}.
Niambi enters the battlefield, returning Deputy of Acquittals from the battlefield to your hand and causing you to gain two life.
Cast Deputy of Acquittals by paying {0}.
Deputy of Acquittals enters the battlefield, returning Niambi from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1315-1850-4426.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1315-1850-4426.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

2178-2545-3524-4096-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Golbin Welder.
Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2545-3524-4096-4659.description:
Sacrifice Gleaming Barrier to Krark-Clan Ironworks, adding {C}{C} and {W} with the treasure token and putting a Thornbite Staff trigger onto the stack.
Holding priority, tap Goblin Welder, sacrificing Idol of Endurance and returning Gleaming Barrier to the battlefield.
Allow the Thornbite Staff trigger to resolve, untapping Goblin Welder.
Tap Goblin Welder, sacrificing Gleaming Barrier and returning Idol of Endurance to the battlefield, triggering Thornbite Staff to untap Goblin Welder and adding {W} through the treasure generated.
Idol of Endurance ETBs and exiles Gleaming Barrier from your graveyard.
Tap Idol of Endurance and spend {1}{W} to allow yourself to cast Gleaming Barrier for free.
Repeat for infinite colored and colorless mana.

3055-3118.notablePrerequisites:
Gift of Immortality attached to Bearer of the Heavens.
You have a way to cause Bearer of the Heavens to die.
3055-3118.description:
Cause Bearer of the Heavens to die.
Bearer of the Heavens dies, triggering itself and Gift of Immortality.
Resolve Gift of Immortality's ability, returning Bearer of the Heavens from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a delayed trigger.
Resolve the Bearer of the Heavens ability, creating another delayed trigger.
At the beginning of the next end step, both delayed triggered abilities go on the stack.
Resolve Gift of Immortality's, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Bearer of the Heavens.
Resolve the Bearer of the Heavens ability, destroying all permanents.
Repeat from step 2.
